body.statement: For every fixed \(D_{\mathrm{gap}}<\infty\), can the singular joint Gaussian and HAC mapping handle establish \(\sup_{(P_j)_{j\geq1}\in\mathcal M(D_{\mathrm{gap}})}\mathbb E_{P_n}[\sup_x|\Pr_{P_n}\{(\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{gap}}-\tau)/\widehat{\operatorname{se}}_{\widehat J_A}\leq x\mid\mathcal F_A\}-\Phi(x)|]\to0\), where the supremum ranges over whole triangular arrays satisfying \(\sup_{j\geq1}|\sqrt j(L_{1,j}-L_{2,j})|\leq D_{\mathrm{gap}}\), the stacked long-run covariance may be positive semidefinite, \(\operatorname{Var}(D)\geq\nu\), and \(V_s^{\mathrm{gap}}\geq V_s\geq\nu\) for both roles?
body.justification: This is the unresolved theorem-assembly bottleneck needed for a practical correction that remains valid at local role ties and singular joint covariances.
body.gap: Lunde supplies separated-block distributional transfer and Andrews supplies HAC consistency, but neither composes proximal inverse estimation, fitted-score replacement, scalar studentization, and discontinuous role selection uniformly on this covariance class.
body.consumer: A positive answer yields selector-conditional Wald inference for a predeclared two-role robustness redesign without estimating the non-identifiable local loss drift.
